📖 Description

Uncrafting is a Fabric mod for Minecraft that adds crafting recipes for items that are normally unobtainable through crafting, while keeping the game balanced and progression-friendly.

The goal of the mod is to reduce reliance on RNG, villagers, or rare structures, without making powerful items too easy to obtain.

The mod does not add new items or blocks.
It simply expands vanilla crafting in a logical and fair way.

✨ Features

Uncrafting adds crafting recipes for the following items:

🕊️ Elytra

Uses End-related and overworld materials

Requires real End progression (Shulker Shells, Ender Eye, Phantom Membrane)

🛡️ Totem of Undying

Balanced mid-game recipe

Preserves its value as a rare survival item

🍎 Enchanted Golden Apple (Notch Apple)

Very expensive recipe, inspired by older Minecraft versions

Does not break game balance

🔱 Trident

Combines ocean progression with Trial Chambers content

Alternative to random mob drops

🏷️ Name Tag

Simple and accessible recipe

Useful when villagers are hard to find

🐎 Horse Armor

Iron Horse Armor

Golden Horse Armor

Diamond Horse Armor

All horse armors use consistent, logical recipes involving minerals and a saddle.

⚖️ Balance Philosophy

Designed for survival gameplay

Maintains vanilla progression

No overpowered early-game recipes

Safe to add to existing worlds

🧪 Compatibility

✔ Minecraft 1.21.5
✔ Fabric Loader
✔ Fabric API
✔ Compatible with most mods
✔ Does not modify loot tables or world generation

📦 Installation

Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.5

Install Fabric API

Place the .jar file into your mods folder

Launch the game

🔧 Technical Notes

No configuration required

No custom blocks or items

Recipes are defined entirely via JSON

Server-safe

💬 Feedback & Suggestions

Suggestions for:

New crafting recipes

Balance adjustments

Optional configuration

Future updates

are always welcome.
